First, note: Europe/Paris in 1258 would have used local mean time based on longitude, not modern CET/CEST.  
Paris is at approximately 2°20′E, which is about +0h 9m 20s ahead of UTC (GMT).  

9:00 PM UTC = 21:00 UTC.  
Add 0h 9m 20s → 21:09:20 local mean time in Paris.  

Date remains March 2, 1258 (no modern DST or time zone changes).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 21:09
